# Linked Structure of Trees

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Linked Structure of Trees

### The Special Container

The special container will store the references to all the children of a node. Think of it as a vector where each element is a pointer to a child node.

![Contents of the Container](data:image/png;base64,)

As an example, let's see how the special container connects node A to one of its children (say, node B).

![Connection of Parent Node A With Its Child Node B](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, if we combine this with all other children, we'll get our linked structure of trees.

![Linked Structure of General Trees](data:image/png;base64,)
